diffuseAlbedo.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: optics.luminousReflectance (0.644, manufacturer) for L*; the palette entry's research.needed (no a* b* measured)
diffuseAlbedo.note: a* and b* are a first warm ivory until a specimen of Crema Marfil is measured (Palette.json: research.needed).

refractiveIndex.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: optics.specularF0 (0.0533, calcite grains in random orientations)
refractiveIndex.derivation: n = (1 + sqrt(F0)) / (1 - sqrt(F0)), the index whose normal-incidence reflectance is the record's F0

wettingDepth.note: A dense stone takes water only into its outer millimetre; no measured depth was read.

grain.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: unverified (the crackle's cell size, 0.25 to 0.4 m)
grain.note: A micritic limestone: its calcite grains are finer than the eye resolves; the stylolite crackle is its coarsest structure.

bed.source: Data/Matter/Substances/cream-marble.json identity.identifiedFrom[0] (grade design): the old build drew 'a crackle of fine grey veins round cells 25-40 cm across, a finer set in patches, over a soft cloud' (windows/Scripts/stone_textures.py, frozen reference; plan/boards/MaterialsStone.png); also Docs/Matter/cream-marble.md line 177
bed.note: Verified in the project records. The value is the design's crackle cell, and 'design' is the honest grade. The 250 to 400 mm range is the stated 25 to 40 cm. The stylolite network is recorded in cream-marble.json chosenBecause (Lopez-Buendia et al. 2013, abstract), which gives no cell size; I did not open that paper. A measurement on a Crema Marfil Coto slab is still needed.

bedAspect.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: unverified (the crackle's cell size, 0.25 to 0.4 m)
bedAspect.note: How much finer the veining is across its run than along it, read from trade photographs.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: unverified (the crackle's cell size, 0.25 to 0.4 m)
toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across a face, from its veins and clasts.

roughnessSpread.source: Workings/honed.json: unverified surface.microRoughness (no filtered roughness read)
roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across a honed face, as the travertine's.

absorption.source: Substances/cream-marble.json: optics.subsurfaceReference.absorption (Jensen, Marschner, Levoy & Hanrahan 2001, measured marble)
absorption.note: A measured white marble stands in for the Crema Marfil until the stone is measured.
